timeline.summary: Skipper Limited announced credit rating reaffirmation and withdrawal by Acuite Ratings across ₹3,433 Cr of facilities on 22 April 2026.
Skipper Limited received an SGST demand of ₹45.11 Lakh for FY2021-22 mismatch on 23 April 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,666.58 Cr (+29.4% YoY), net profit ₹78.06 Cr (+62.9% YoY).
Skipper Limited reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹5,553 Cr (+20.1% YoY) and net profit of ₹207 Cr (+42.2% YoY) alongside a record order book of ₹8,502 Cr.
Skipper Limited hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call on 28 April 2026, guiding for 15% revenue growth and 30% PAT growth in FY27.
Skipper Limited secured new T&D orders worth ₹1,265 crores spanning domestic 765 Kv and 400 Kv line projects and LATAM export markets.
Skipper's board approved a ₹433.50 Cr preferential share issue to institutional investors.
Skipper incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Skipper Transmission And Distribution - L.L.C - S.P.C, in Abu Dhabi on May 22, 2026.
Skipper Limited concluded its postal ballot on 6th June 2026 regarding AoA amendments and managerial remuneration revisions.
On 24th July 2026, Skipper announced that the Principal Commissioner (Appeals) set aside the department's appeal regarding a ₹10.21 Cr GST demand.
Skipper completed its preferential issue by allotting 92,23,402 equity shares at ₹470 per share, raising ₹433.50 crores.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,309.83 Cr (+4.5% YoY), net profit ₹56.81 Cr (+25.5% YoY).
Skipper Limited presented Q1FY27 investor update, reaffirming FY27 guidance of ~15% revenue and ~30% PAT growth with a record ₹9,217 Cr order book.
Skipper reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹1,309.83 Cr (+4.5% YoY) and net profit of ₹56.51 Cr (+26.5% YoY) with a record ₹9,217 Cr order book.
Skipper Limited shared Q1FY27 results conference call recording on 12th August 2026 via its investor relations website.
Skipper Limited hosted its Q1FY27 earnings conference call on August 12, 2026, reiterating its FY27 revenue growth guidance of ~15% and PAT growth of ~30%.
Skipper Limited secured ₹1,305 Cr in domestic and international T&D orders from PGCIL and North American customers.
Management led by **Anu Singh** will attend Anand Rathi G-200 Summit 2026 on **22nd September 2026** (physical).

Skipper Limited’s Annual General Meeting on September 15, 2026, passed all agenda items with unanimous shareholder approval via e-voting under scrutinizer Mr. Raj Kumar Banthia (Membership No. A17190).
Skipper Limited secured ₹797 Cr in domestic and international T&D orders from Australia and a domestic developer.
Skipper Limited’s management, led by **Anu Singh**, will attend the Nuvama Emerging India CEO Forum investor conference physically on **28th September 2026**.
Skipper Limited received a ₹227.53 Cr GST show cause notice from Odisha tax authorities, which the company is contesting.
Crisil reaffirmed Skipper's long-term rating at A+/Stable on ₹5,106 Cr of facilities and short-term at A1 on ₹4,621 Cr.
